description: Runs Nx workspace commands and returns structured per-project task results with cache status.

affected.description: Run target only for affected projects (default: false)

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to nx.

configuration.description: Build configuration to use (e.g., 'production', 'development'). Maps to --configuration.

dryRun.description: Preview the task graph without executing (maps to --dry-run)

exclude.description: Projects to exclude from run-many (maps to --exclude)

graph.description: Generate the task graph visualization (maps to --graph)

head.description: Head ref for affected comparison (maps to --head)

nxBail.description: Stop task execution after the first failure (maps to --nx-bail)

parallel.description: Max number of parallel tasks (maps to --parallel)

project.description: Specific project to run the target for

projects.description: Specific projects to include in run-many (maps to --projects)

skipNxCache.description: Skip the Nx cache and re-run all tasks (maps to --skip-nx-cache)

verbose.description: Enable verbose output for debugging (maps to --verbose)

name: nx

cache.description: Cache state: local hit, remote hit, or miss (no cache)

title: nx
